topic_zh: 估算入门：QPS 怎么算（日活 × 次数 ÷ 86400）

xhs.title: 一亿日活QPS多少？30秒算出来
xhs.body:
面试被问 QPS，其实就一个公式：
平均 QPS ≈ 日活 × 每人每天次数 ÷ 86400（一天的秒数）
心算把 86400 当 10 万：1 亿 × 10 次 ÷ 10 万 ≈ 1 万（精确约 1.2 万）
流量不是平的，常用经验法则：峰值 ≈ 平均的 2~3 倍，机器要按峰值准备。
考考你：1000 万日活，每人每天 20 次，平均 QPS 约 2300 还是 2.3 万？评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body:
100M daily users, 10 requests each: what QPS? DAU × requests ÷ 86,400 ≈ 12K average; peak is roughly 2–3× that.
Quiz: 10M users, 20 requests each. Average QPS about 2,300 or 23,000?

linkedin.title: Estimating QPS takes one formula and 30 seconds.
linkedin.body:
Average QPS ≈ daily users × requests per user per day ÷ 86,400 (seconds in a day).
100M users × 10 requests ≈ 1B a day ÷ 86,400 ≈ 12K QPS. Round 86,400 to 100K for mental math.
Traffic isn't flat: a common rule of thumb is peak ≈ 2–3× average, and capacity is planned for the peak. The cost is idle servers off-peak.
Quick quiz: 10M daily users, 20 requests each. Is the average QPS about 2,300 or 23,000?
